title: now_utc_string: hand-rolled civil_from_days is needlessly complex for this use
description: helpers.rs now_utc_string uses a full Howard Hinnant calendar algorithm. The only caller is generating a default receivedAt timestamp (EmailSubmission/set sendAt). The algorithm is correct but is 13 lines of bit-twiddling integer arithmetic for a function that has exactly one call site and could instead just return a fixed-format string from SystemTime and a stdlib formatter. Alternatives: add chrono (already likely in workspace) or use jmap_types::UTCDate::now() if that exists. Leave as-is only if no dependency is available.
